sloka: दु:शील: कामवृत्तो वा धनैवा परिवर्जित: ।स्त्रीणामार्यस्वभावानां परमं दैवतं पति: ॥ २.११७.२२॥
transliteration: du:śīla: kāmavṛtto vā dhanaivā parivarjita: ।strīṇāmāryasvabhāvānāṁ paramaṁ daivataṁ pati: ॥ 2.117.22॥

translations.english: One who is devoted to her husband, whether he be in the city or in the forest, whether he is sinful or virtuous, will attain the most prosperous worlds.
